note: Webpack and Rsbuild builds hold every style in their stylesheets: a stylesheet module is built on its first import, so styles extracted later (the global styles of files webpack or Rsbuild reached late, often outside `src`) were missing from the output. The files the entries reach under `src` are now extracted before the build, the shared base on disk is kept current, and when a stylesheet still changed during the build it is compiled once more, writing only the complete result. Rsbuild serves each stylesheet from the current sheet instead of a module-wide string kept only when it grew, which left edits that shortened the CSS and later builds in the same process stale. plugin-utils adds computeReachableFiles
